chapter_title: The Theft of the Rimet Cup
title: An Impromptu Party
subtitle: The wet marks left by the bubble festival dry up and disappear under the sun, along with some strange encounters.

items.text: It's beautiful!
This is what Father used to protect.
But, it is mine now.
Heh heh, the robots can't tell real fire from fake. Just a few sheets of nitrate flash paper, they'd turn on all the fire sprinklers loyally.
Then, a steady stream mixed with slug essence from the fire water reservoir gushed out of the sprinkler heads.
Ms. Acey, did you see how the robots were glued to the floor, unable to move? If they had emotions, they would have cursed me to death. Heh heh!
Are you satisfied with the answer, Ms. Acey?

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: One last to go, Melania.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Huuhh! What a strict mentor!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: No worries. I will get back to the hotel as planned, right on the dot!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: *humming*

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: The next stop is Room 1132, Insomnia Nighty Hotel.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Get to Regent Street. Take a rest on the bench at the fifth flower bed for 3 minutes and 25 seconds. Then turn into the lane next to Honey Candy House ...

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: Gurrr!
The handbag suddenly starts to shake. It seems it wants to escape from Melania.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Ms. Acey?

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: On your right.
The ground on the right side starts vibrating with the strong beats of music.
A strange fire engine slowly drives into Regent Street.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: What? Wh-What's going on?!
In the witness of the crowd, the fire engine with strange patterns raises a bucket above the water tank. A glossy soap bubble comes out. Then more of the distorting, mirror-like spheres follow.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Fire engine ... bubbles ... ?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Is this the latest way to extinguish fire? But why is it here?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: *coughs* There seems to be something wrong with the bubbles.

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: Not good. Leave.
The soap bubbles glisten in the sun. But what is shown on their reflective surface seems unusual.
Melania shields her eyes cautiously and runs in the opposite direction.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Oh, right. Only three minutes left. I ... I must go now.
Bump!

items.speaker: A Happy Passerby
items.text: Don't stand in the way, hey! That's not the direction, boy!

items.speaker: A Joyful Passerby
items.text: Ah, I see. That's a ski resort on the snowy mountain. Best place for vacation.
Enticed by the visions of their dream lives reflected in the bubbles, the passersby are now moving slowly in one direction.
They all walk in the same direction, and not a single man can reverse the flow. The crowd eventually stops at the fire engine.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Hey, hey! Don't push me! Wait!
Someone sticks his head out of the car window.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Elders and youngsters, friends who are passionate or reserved!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Welcome to the Bang Bang Frisbee Rock 'n' Roll Party!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: This is an improvised and liberated event of art that everybody can join!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: This is the Utopia, where you can totally voyage far even with myopia. This is our world in the future. Hee hee ha!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Who's this?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Ugh! A knobhead causing traffic jams on my way?

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: There's no time.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Huumm.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Okay. Take it easy. Take it easy. Just fix these bubbles.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: There must be something that works. Disguising caps, sticky balls, hiding cups ...

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: Arrrggghhh.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Found it! The Smart Detergent Gun!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Twenty-three detergent balls at one shot. In a flash, it will make this place shiny as new.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Heh heh, perfect answer! Give me back my empty streets!
She fires the gun. Several dark-green bullets shoot out at the floating soap bubbles, and the scene is like a fireworks show.

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: Don't.

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: It's ... Super Absorbent.
Soon, the bubbles are gathered together by an unknown force and form a huge, transparent globe.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Oh, my adorable bubbles. Look how you embrace each other enthusiastically! Take it away! It is the summon of Euterpe, the revelation of Terpsichore.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Haha! Thank you so much! That avant-garde, courageous, and innovative girl in the leather cap!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Ah ...
The crowd seems to be deeply caught in their reveries, believing what they see in the bubbles to be true.
This is an unexpected party.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: These unplanned and inexplicable things ... Ah, I think I'm also affected by the visions.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: The traffic is totally congested. No chance to get back to normal in 2 minutes and 25 seconds.
Leather shoes, glasses, dog leashes, and frisbees have all been thrown into the sky. The crowd becomes even crazier.
Those who walk in the opposite direction block Melania's way. Her body and her mind have been pushed backward.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Honey Candy House ... Insomnia Nighty Hotel ...

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Calm down, Melania.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: You've sorted out a roadmap of all the blocks in London. You need a new plan, a bold new plan.
A tramp in the restless crowd is extremely happy. He freely walks in the crowd and takes Melania's handbag precisely.

items.speaker: Tramp
items.text: Woaaaa! Parties, parties! Throw them to the sky! Your magazines, your handbags ... Everything!

items.speaker: Tramp
items.text: Celebraaaate! Hahahahaha!

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Hey! That's my magazine! What are you doing?!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: What are you going to do with Ms. Acey? Give it back to me!

The soap bubbles, also the mind fragments of Diggers's, float around the tramp and fill him with confidence. He feels himself the most powerful, fearless, and courageous, like Hercules defending his war trophy.

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Watch out. He's mad!

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Geez! I can't tell his strength just from his appearance!

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Phew, well, um, Ms. Melania, thank you for your ... bewildering variety of gadget. I would have been in trouble otherwise!

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: If there is anything I can do for you, please let me know.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Time is over. My plan ... It all ...
The girl holding the handbag drops her shoulders. It seems she still lingers in a world of depression.

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Miss ...?

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Oh, no, you're not under the influence of Reflective Bubble, are you? That's not good. You need to wake up before the police come!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: The police?!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: You're right. I haven't finished my answer sheet. There are way more important things to do. I can't get stuck here. Huuhh!
She wipes her face, takes several deep breaths, and calms down.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Please, show me to the hotel, the one nearest to here and farthest from the police station, if you really want to thank me.

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Err, Re-Rest Inn? Maybe you could take your chances there. A better choice would be Insomnia Nighty Hotel, but apparently, the way there is blocked by the stupid fire engine.

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Rest Inn is around the third corner down the lane from here. By the way, stay away from those nutters dancing in bubbles and keep an eye on your handbag, so you don't end up like me.
He takes a glance at the worn-out magazine, World Soccer, in his hand and sighs.

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Huuhh! I managed to grab it from the newsagent's, and this is what happened!

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Oh, my Rimet Cup legend. I bought it for my collection precisely because of the column topic in this issue.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: The Rimet Cup?

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Yes, you know it too? The same trophy that was won by Brazil four years ago!

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: It's suddenly missing during the exhibition and was replaced with a counterfeit by a thief when nobody knew. The security company failed to do anything and thus paid out a huge compensation.

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: The genuine thing was only found in the trash months later. That legendary trophy has now arrived in London. It will be the most wonderful award given to the winner!
While Charlton is fully wrapped up in the excitement of sharing his story, a huge bubble is slowly turning this way. It is attracted by his story too, obviously.
Bang!
A smell of sour flame wine soon surrounds him.

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: *coughs* Whoaaa!
Charlton feels a sharp sting in the nose. This is one of the awful side effects brought by these soap bubbles—they don't burst, instead, they capture their prey with invisible, frizzy antennae.
Something seems to be burning in Charlton's head. The next second, the colorful bubble hits him with a gentle bump.

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Am I seeing things?! This is actually a celebration party for England! And it's the biggest ever, wah-hahaha!

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Pickles, Pickles, come on!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Mr. Charlton, are you ... all right?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: It's March. Still quite a long way to go before the World Cup final.

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Is it?

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Thank you for reminding me. I need to tell Pickles in case he goes there for nothing.
Charlton is about to leave.

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Pickles, my little Pickles!
He staggers a few steps and falls to the ground.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Huuhh! He shouldn't have let his guard down. The bubbles from the fire engine must have been turned into a sort of lifeform by some specific incantations. Huuhh! Poor Mr. Charlton.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: I suggest you try some of this.
Melania takes a bottle of mist spray from her handbag and sprays it at Charlton's nose.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Stinky Mud Freshener. It cleans the air nearby with its brutal destructive power, only with a slight side effect.

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Poof! *coughs*
The tip of Charlton's nose becomes red. He sits on the ground, gasps for a while, and gradually calms down.

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Ah, I feel so much better now. I almost couldn't breathe. Phew!
He is about to say thank you, but soon realizes the girl with a handbag has gone.

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: Hey! Thank you, Ms. Melania!

items.speaker: Charlton
items.text: God bless you and have a safe journey!
He wipes out the dust on his clothes but finds the magazine missing. Instead, there's a strange bottle of mist spray in his hand.
Melania puts a worn-out magazine into her handbag.
After taking several more corners, she will arrive at the newly set destination—Rest Inn.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: You're welcome, Mr. Charlton. I think the Stinky Mud Freshener would suit you better.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: God bless you to find your little Pickles soon.
TO BE CONTINUED ...
